title: spec(migrations): the unreleased `18.packageless-overlay-write-closed` prose says an email_template row at a locale the base doesn't ship fails to move and every move declares `overrides`; PR #29258 changes both
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ② text drift that another PR will make false, named by server seat 5 from #28904 (PR #29258, seat ACCEPT). Filed by `domain:spec#1` because the text is in `packages/spec`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Blocked-by: #29258 (re-read the ceremony's outcome once it merges; until then the prose is still true).

## Where (on `main`)

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packageless-overlay-write-closed.ts`: the replacement prose (≈L26–40). It says a move declares `overrides: { package: <base>, basedOn: … }`, and it lists "an email template locale the base does not ship" among the rows that fail to move.
- The unreleased root changeset `.changeset/28576-packageless-overlay-write-closed.md` (≈L39–49) has the same two claims: the FROM → TO example declares `overrides`, and the "Still open" list ends "an `email_template` locale the base does not ship (the pair refuses it, #28777; the ceremony's move of it is #28904)".

## What will be true after PR #29258

`os migrate packageless-overlays` moves a package-less `email_template` row at a locale the base doesn't ship as the pair's OWN member. It declares nothing, the outcome is `moved`, and the row carries `addedMember`. So "every move declares `overrides`" and "such a row fails to move" both become false.

## Wanted

Once #29258 merges, re-read both texts against the ceremony's real outcomes and correct them. Name the `addedMember` outcome next to the declared-override one, and drop the email-locale case from the rows that fail to move. The changeset is pending (unreleased), so a correction is the deliberate-correction class (`check-empty-changeset` exit 1 by design). Spec patch, `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Reader who acts: `domain:spec`, or #29258's own dev if they fold it in before merge.

Dedupe: searched `packageless-overlay-write-closed addedMember`, `email_template locale pair own member migrate`. Only #28904, #28777, #28576 and PR #29258. **New.**
